message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Inventory Growth Rate", "construction": "Annual percentage change in inventories (from Compustat item INVT) over the prior fiscal year.", "rationale": "Firms with rapidly growing inventories may be overestimating future demand or accumulating unsold goods, leading to poorer future performance.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Cash Flow Consistency", "construction": "Standard deviation of annual operating cash flow (Compustat OANCF) over the past five years, divided by average total assets (AT); lower values indicate more consistent cash flow.", "rationale": "Firms with more stable cash flows are less likely to face financial distress, possibly commanding a return premium.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Short-Term Debt Surge", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage increase in short-term debt (Compustat DLC) relative to total assets (AT).", "rationale": "A sudden surge in short-term debt may indicate liquidity stress or upcoming financial difficulties.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Marketing Expense Intensity", "construction": "Advertising expense (from 10-K footnotes or Compustat XAD if available) divided by sales (SALE).", "rationale": "Firms investing heavily in marketing may be able to build brand and drive future growth, or may be compensating for weak products.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "CEO Tenure", "construction": "Number of years since the most recent CEO appointment (from company filings and annual reports).", "rationale": "Longer-tenured CEOs may indicate management stability, while very new CEOs might signal upcoming strategic change or risk.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Downward Earnings Revision Frequency", "construction": "Count of downward changes in consensus analyst earnings estimates (I/B/E/S data) over the previous 12 months.", "rationale": "Frequent negative earnings revisions may indicate deteriorating fundamentals unpriced by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Asset Sale Frequency", "construction": "Number of non-core asset sales (disclosed in 10-K or press releases) in past two years.", "rationale": "Frequent asset sales could signal attempts to boost short-term results or financial stress.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Patent Count Growth", "construction": "Percentage growth in cumulative US patents granted to the firm over the past three years (USPTO data).", "rationale": "Increasing patent counts may indicate innovation pipelines that drive future growth.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Dividend Omission Indicator", "construction": "Binary indicator equal to one if the firm has omitted a regular cash dividend in the past year.", "rationale": "Dividend omissions may be a distress signal not fully reflected in stock prices.", "higher_returns_for": "zero values of the measure"}, {"name": "Year-over-Year Insider Net Buying", "construction": "Net number of shares bought by insiders (officer and director Form 4 filings) over the prior 12 months, scaled by shares outstanding.", "rationale": "Insider buying can signal undervaluation or managerial confidence in future prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}]}
